def _mk_dirs_for_file(filepath):
    """Make all dirs specified for final file.

    >>> _mk_dirs_for_file("~/new-dir/some-file.txt")
    """
    dirs = os.path.split(filepath)[0]
    try:
        os.makedirs(dirs)
    except FileExistsError:
        # TODO: Logg INFO level
        pass
